Tissue replacement therapies are showing they can cure Parkinson's, blindness, even spinal cord injury - and yet most patients would never be able to afford or get access to them, because they're produced manually. So we decided to fix that with automated production.
We're building and operating fully automated cell manufacturing sites to scale production of Regenerative Medicines at low cost to billions of patients.

Six years ago, we started automating production of stem cell derived cells such as heart and brain tissue for R&D use in the largest US Pharma companies (including 3 of top 20) - and we've taken our iDEM automated technology through 6 generations of refinement and iteration since.

Mytos is a leader in automating cell manufacture. The company’s platform enables life sciences companies to grow human cells with unparalleled precision and efficiency. Mytos has assembled a world-class team of engineers and scientists to develop an automated platform to accelerate the development of life-saving therapies. The company is based in London, UK. , an innovative leader in automated cell manufacturing, announced today it has closed $19M in Series A financing led by Buckley Ventures, with participation from IQ Capital and Wing VC.

The funding will accelerate the manufacturing and distribution of Mytos’ automated cell production system to more biotech and pharma companies to meet growing demand. Mytos builds robots for manufacturing human cells. Operators input stem cells, and our platform turns them into specific cells such as neurons and heart cells over multiple weeks.

Mytos has fully automated production of these cells, making it scalable. We have our first manufacturing deal - neurons for treating Parkinson’s - and we’re in conversations with majority of the other top players.
Automated workflows reduce contamination risk and variability, improving yield and consistency while lowering production costs and accelerating timelines from weeks to scalable manufacturing[2][5].
